+{% if postrow.rewards %}
+  <a data-toggle="modal" data-id="{{ postrow.POST_ID }}" href="#ReactionDialog" class="open-ReactionDialog btn btn-default">{{ lang('OTHERS') }}</a>
+  <div class="btn-group btn-group-sm" role="group">
+    <button class="btn btn-default btn-sm dropdown-toggle" type="button" data-toggle="dropdown" aria-haspopup="true" aria-expanded="false">
+      {{ lang('BBREACTION_WHAT') }}
+      <span class="caret"></span>
+    </button>
+    <ul class="dropdown-menu">
+      <!-- BEGIN postrow.rewards -->
+      <li {% if postrow.rewards.SEPERATOR %} style="border-left:#C6C6C6 thin solid;padding-left:4px;" {% endif %}>
+        <a class="bbreactionbtn reward" href="#p{{ postrow.POST_ID }}" data-options="p={{ postrow.POST_ID }}&e={{ postrow.rewards.TYPE_ID }}">
+          <i class="fa {{ postrow.rewards.SYMBOL }}" style="font-size:1.6em;color:{% if postrow.rewards.S_POSITIVE %}green{% else %}red{% endif %};"></i><br/>
+          {{ postrow.rewards.TITLE }}<br/>
+          <span id="p{{ postrow.POST_ID ~ postrow.rewards.TYPE_ID }}">{{ postrow.rewards.PERCENT }}</span></a>
+      </li>
+      <!-- END postrow.rewards -->
+    </ul>
+  </div>
+{% endif %}

+			$this->db->sql_freeresult($result);
+			if (isset($row['type_id'])) {
+				$post_row['CURRENT_USER_REWARD_CLASSLIST'] = 'fa ' . $row['symbol'];
+				$post_row['CURRENT_USER_REWARD_CONTENTS'] = '';
+				$post_row['CURRENT_USER_REWARD_S_POSITIVE'] = ($row['positive']) ? true : false;
+			}
+			/**
+			 * Event to modify latest reward
+			 *
+			 * @event sitesplat.bbreaction.listener_viewtopic_handle_posts
+			 * @var	array	row		Latest Reward data
+			 * @var	array	ary_tpl	Current reward template array
+			 * @since 1.3.0
+			 */
+			$vars = array(
+				'post_row',
+				'row'
+			);
+			extract($this->phpbb_dispatcher->trigger_event('sitesplat.bbreaction.listener_viewtopic_handle_posts_latest_reaction', compact($vars)));
+
+			$sql = 'SELECT t.*, u.username, u.user_colour, u.user_id, GROUP_CONCAT(t.positive ORDER BY t.symbol) as positives, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.symbol ORDER BY t.symbol) as symbols, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.emoji ORDER BY t.symbol) as emojis 
+				FROM ' . $this->reward_table . ' r
+				INNER JOIN ' . $this->reward_type_table . ' t ON t.type_id = r.like_type AND t.active = 1
+				INNER JOIN ' . USERS_TABLE . ' u ON u.user_id = r.user_id
+				WHERE r.post_id = ' . $post_row['POST_ID'] . '
+				GROUP BY r.user_id 
+				ORDER BY r.like_time DESC';
+
+			$result = $this->db->sql_query_limit($sql, 4);
+			$rewards = [];
+			$i = 0;
+			while ($row = $this->db->sql_fetchrow($result)) {
+				if ($i < 3) {
+					if (!empty($row['symbols'])) {
+						$symbols = explode(",", $row['symbols']);
+						$symbols_rendered = [];
+						foreach ($symbols as $symbol) {
+							$symbols_rendered[] = ['SYMBOL' => 'fa ' . $symbol];
+						}
+					}
+					$positives_rendered = [];
+					if (!empty($row['positives'])) {
+						$positives = explode(",", $row['positives']);
+						foreach ($positives as $positive) {
+							$positives_rendered[] = ['POSITIVE' => (bool) $positive];
+						}
+					}
+
+					$reward = array(
+						'USERNAME' => $row['username'],
+						'U_USERNAME' => generate_board_url() . '/memberlist.php?mode=viewprofile&amp;u=' . $row['user_id'],
+						'USER_COLOUR' => $row['user_colour'],
+						'CLASSLIST' => $symbols_rendered,
+						'CONTENTS' => '',
+						'S_POSITIVE' => $positives_rendered,
+					);
+
+					/**
+					 * Event to modify latest rewards
+					 *
+					 * @event sitesplat.bbreaction.listener_viewtopic_handle_posts
+					 * @var	array	row		Latest Reward data
+					 * @var	array	ary_tpl	Current reward template array
+					 * @since 1.3.0
+					 */
+					$vars = array(
+						'reward',
+						'row'
+					);
+					extract($this->phpbb_dispatcher->trigger_event('sitesplat.bbreaction.listener_viewtopic_handle_posts_latest_reactions', compact($vars)));
+					$rewards[] = $reward;
+				}
+				$i += 1;
+			}
+
+			$post_row['SHOW_OTHERS'] = $i > 3;
+			$post_row['latest_rewards'] = $rewards;
+			$this->db->sql_freeresult($result);
 			$event['post_row'] = $post_row;
 		}
 	}

+{% if postrow.enable_rewards and postrow.latest_rewards %}
+<div class="all-reactions pull-right">
+	{% for latest_reward in postrow.latest_rewards %}
+	<div class="label label-huskygray">
+		<a href="{{ latest_reward.U_USERNAME }}" style="color: #{{ latest_reward.USER_COLOUR }}">
+			{{ latest_reward.USERNAME }}
+		</a>
+		<span>
+		{% if latest_reward.CLASSLIST %}
+			{% for classlists in latest_reward.CLASSLIST %}
+				{% if latest_reward.CONTENTS[loop.index0].EMOJI %}
+					<i>{{ latest_reward.CONTENTS[loop.index0].EMOJI }}</i>
+				{% else %}
+					<i style="padding:4px 0;vertical-align:bottom;color:{% if not latest_reward.S_POSITIVE[loop.index0].POSITIVE %}red{% else %}green{% endif %};" class="{{ classlists.SYMBOL }}"></i>
+				{% endif %}
+			{% endfor %}
+		{% endif %}
+		</span>
+	</div>
+	{% endfor %}
+	{% if postrow.SHOW_OTHERS %}<a data-toggle="modal" data-id="{{ postrow.POST_ID }}" href="#ReactionDialog" class="open-ReactionDialog btn btn-xs btn-link">{{ lang('BBREACTION_OTHERS') }}</a>{% endif %}
+</div>
+{% endif %}
\ No newline at end of file

+{% if postrow.enable_rewards and postrow.latest_rewards %}
+<div class="all-reactions pull-right">
+	{% for latest_reward in postrow.latest_rewards %}
+	<div class="label label-huskygray">
+		<a href="{{ latest_reward.U_USERNAME }}" style="color: #{{ latest_reward.USER_COLOUR }}">
+			{{ latest_reward.USERNAME }}
+		</a>
+		<span>
+		{% if latest_reward.CLASSLIST %}
+			{% for classlists in latest_reward.CLASSLIST %}
+				{% if latest_reward.CONTENTS[loop.index0].EMOJI %}
+					<i>{{ latest_reward.CONTENTS[loop.index0].EMOJI }}</i>
+				{% else %}
+					<i style="padding:4px 0;vertical-align:bottom;color:{% if not latest_reward.S_POSITIVE[loop.index0].POSITIVE %}red{% else %}green{% endif %};" class="{{ classlists.SYMBOL }}"></i>
+				{% endif %}
+			{% endfor %}
+		{% endif %}
+		</span>
+	</div>
+	{% endfor %}
+	{% if postrow.SHOW_OTHERS %}<a data-toggle="modal" data-id="{{ postrow.POST_ID }}" href="#ReactionDialog" class="open-ReactionDialog btn btn-xs btn-link">{{ lang('BBREACTION_OTHERS') }}</a>{% endif %}
+</div>
+{% endif %}
\ No newline at end of file
